description.7.0: Updates associated with geometric or property changes are performed at the start of every model solve command (including model step and model cycle). In large strain mode, these calculations are also updated every 10 steps by default. The number of steps between these large strain updates can be change with this command to every i steps.
description.9.0: Set a specific interval of steps at which to update zone geometry and property changes in large strain mode. Updates associated with geometric or property changes are performed at the start of every model solve command (including model step and model cycle ). In large strain mode, these calculations are also updated every 10 steps by default; use of this command will change that to updating every i steps. In the 9.x series the official command form is 'zone geometry update-interval'; the legacy 7.0 form 'zone geometry-update' is still accepted by FLAC3D 9.7.

verification: 7.0: availability verified against official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index (https://docs.itascacg.com/flac3d700/flac3d/zone/doc/manual/zone_manual/zone_commands/cmd_zone.geometry-update.html); syntax from official FLAC3D 7.0 detailed command page.
